patch_description:
Replace the current over-parameterized ansatz block (which uses extra pre/post Z layers and only three CRZ gates) with a simpler, higher-capacity-per-parameter structure inspired by the stronger prior candidates:
- Keep an initial layer of single-qubit RY on all 8 qubits.
- Use the same fixed CZ “pairs” as in the previous best patterns.
- Add a ring-style set of 4 parameterized CRX gates (one per entangling edge), using fewer parameters than the current CRZ+extra RZ layers.
- Finish with a full single-qubit RZ layer on all 8 qubits.

This reduces N_PARAMS_PER_BLOCK from 27 → 20 (so N_PARAMS from 164 → 122 under the fixed training loop), while increasing entangling expressivity (CRX ring) relative to the current CRZ-only middle layer.
